author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Persimmon season brings beautiful color and natural sweetness to the village 🍂🫙 In this video, we harvest ripe persimmons and turn them into several homemade treats — a rich syrup, a sweet dessert, and dried fruit prepared for winter.

Some of the persimmons are slowly cooked into a fragrant syrup, while others are used for a simple seasonal dessert. We also dry part of the harvest, preserving the fruit naturally so it can be enjoyed during the colder months.

This is traditional autumn village cooking at its best — harvesting seasonal fruit, enjoying it fresh, and preserving part of it for winter. A warm celebration of persimmon season, homemade food, and simple countryside traditions. 🍊🍁🌿
title: Persimmon Season in the Village | Syrup, Dessert & Drying for Winter 🍂🫙
